title: Thermodynamics of Coherence-Selective Quantum Reset Protocols
summary: We develop an exact theory of coherence-selective stroboscopic resetting for quadratic open quantum systems within the single-particle density-matrix formalism. We focus on the survival of coherences and the associated thermodynamic cost at the stroboscopic fixed point. To this end, we introduce a one-parameter family of reset channels that continuously interpolates between complete coherence erasure and complete coherence preservation.
